title: Pub/Sub order-fulfillment backlog during flash sale; Cloud Run consumers pinned at max instances
alert:
ALERT: PUBSUB_SUBSCRIPTION_BACKLOG
Source: Google Cloud Monitoring (Pub/Sub subscription alert policy)
Project: prod-commerce-4821
Topic: checkout-events
Subscription: order-fulfillment-sub
Region: us-central1
Age of oldest unacked message: 28m 14s (threshold 10m)
Undelivered messages: 184,200 (baseline 200-800)
Publish rate: 9,420 msg/s (+240% vs 7d same hour)
Delivery rate: 3,080 msg/s (flat for 22 min)
Consumer lag derivative: +6,340 msg/s (backlog accelerating)
Correlated signals (auto-attached):
  - run.googleapis.com/container/instance_count order-fulfillment-worker: 60/60 (at max)
  - run.googleapis.com/container/cpu/utilizations: avg 71% (not CPU-saturated)
  - checkout-api POST /v2/checkout HTTP 202 rate: nominal (orders accepted upstream)
  - cloudsql.googleapis.com/database/replication/replica_lag: <2s (nominal)
Business context: flash sale hour, ~$51K/hr checkout GMV; fulfillment SLA 15m p95 currently 41m
Incident: INC-88544
Runbook: https://wiki.internal/runbooks/pubsub-consumer-backlog
context: 2026-06-19T18:02:00Z [change-mgmt] CHG-9201 (Jun 12) note: order-fulfillment-worker Cloud Run max instances reduced 100 -> 60 for cost program
2026-06-19T18:10:00Z [marketing-ops] flash-sale-campaign-47 started; expected 2.5x checkout traffic for 18:00-19:30 UTC
2026-06-19T18:14:00Z [pubsub] checkout-events publish rate crosses 6,000 msg/s (above prior peak 4,100 msg/s)
2026-06-19T18:18:00Z [cloud-run] order-fulfillment-worker scales 42 -> 60 instances in 90s; delivery rate plateaus at ~3,100 msg/s
2026-06-19T18:24:00Z [argo-rollouts] checkout-api v2.14.2 rollout Completed; publisher error rate unchanged
2026-06-19T18:26:00Z [order-portal] customer-support: spike in 'order stuck in processing' chats (checkout succeeded, fulfillment delayed)
2026-06-19T18:32:00Z [vpc-flow-logs] prod-shared-vpc: east-west traffic anomaly on lab-subnet (unrelated test harness)
2026-06-19T18:33:00Z [platform-slack] data-eng: 'anyone else seeing slow Looker dashboards?'
reference_summary: order-fulfillment-sub on checkout-events is backing up during flash-sale-campaign-47 because publish rate jumped to about 9,400 messages per second while consumers can only deliver about 3,100 per second, pushing the oldest unacked message age to 28 minutes and leaving 184,200 undelivered messages. order-fulfillment-worker on Cloud Run is already pinned at its max instance cap of 60 (lowered from 100 by CHG-9201 on Jun 12), CPU is only around 71% so the bottleneck is instance ceiling not per-instance CPU, and checkout-api is still accepting orders with healthy database and cache metrics.
reference_action: Raise order-fulfillment-worker max instances above 60 (or restore the pre-CHG-9201 limit) and request Cloud Run quota headroom if needed per https://wiki.internal/runbooks/pubsub-consumer-backlog, temporarily throttle checkout-events publish rate at checkout-api until age-of-oldest-message falls below 10 minutes, and do not roll back checkout-api v2.14.2 because publisher health and DB metrics are nominal.
